title: Gate swing near a utility cabinet
authority_policy: All project records and measurements are fictional. Owner follow-ups can authorize scope changes; supplier and surveyor statements alone cannot. An owner-approved survey defines the quantity when explicitly adopted. Later dates alone do not establish supersession. Draft proposals are complete only to the extent their text says so. Evaluate documentary consistency, not design safety or code compliance.

source_context.document_identity: UFGS 32 31 13 — Chain Link Fences and Gates; November 2021; downloaded edition references UMRL July 2026
source_context.note: Gate installation must accommodate unobstructed opening.
source_context.use: Factual paraphrase of a guide specification, not a project requirement unless adopted in synthetic records.

paragraphs.text: Replace the garden-service gate at the same opening. We want full opening without striking the utility cabinet.
The cabinet was locked and its door could not be swung. The distance to the proposed gate arc was not measured; inward and outward swing are both sketched without selection.
I cannot select the gate swing until the cabinet clearance is checked. Keep the opening width as measured; swing direction is still undecided.
Manual service gate in existing opening, swing direction pending cabinet-clearance check. Final hardware selection follows the confirmed swing.
